blocks.text: LOS ANGELES, United States — Australian Ben Simmons’s NBA return hit a brutal setback on Sunday as the Sacramento Kings announced the former number one draft pick had torn his right Achilles tendon in training. “Sacramento Kings guard Ben Simmons was injured during a live drill in practice on Sunday,” the Kings said in a statement. “An MRI revealed a torn right Achilles tendon. Simmons will undergo surgery. Further updates will be provided as appropriate.” READ: NBA: Damian Lillard is back on the court for the Trail Blazers Simmons had missed last season with nagging back injuries but agreed to a […]...
